metadata.description: Claude Code mods by MHermand: saiyan, one bar above the prompt with your plan's usage limits and the subagents' progress, and a mascot that wears your model and effort; agents-progress and usage-limits, the two mods it replaces.

plugins.name: saiyan
plugins.description: Mod: one bar above the prompt with two views, your plan's usage limits and the subagents' progress, and a spiky-haired mascot wearing your model and effort; a click on it picks them for your next message. Replaces agents-progress and usage-limits.

plugins.name: agents-progress
plugins.description: Mod, replaced by saiyan: progress bar above the prompt whenever subagents run, a mascot per model, and the list of subagents with steps, cost, tokens and time.

plugins.name: usage-limits
plugins.description: Mod, replaced by saiyan: a slim band above the prompt with your plan usage limits, the 5-hour session and the week: how much is used, when each resets, and whether your pace reaches the limit before then; alerts at 75% and 90%.
